1. Description

This pairing examines the length of the growing season in the contiguous United States (CONUS), defined as the length of time between the last frost of spring and the first frost of fall. It builds upon Figures 1 and 3 in EPA’s Length of Growing Season indicator and includes the following components:

  • Historical observations since 1895.
  • Modeled projections from 2015 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.
  • A modeled hindcast from 1950 to 2014.
